author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After reconnecting with effects artist Martin Meunier, Adam shares an amazing prop he recently received from his former colleage: a giant metal quarter! Adam explains the many different ways a propmaker could make such a piece to hold up to close-up camera scrutiny, and demonstrates its ability to spin on a table like the real thing!

Martin Meunier's groundbreaking stop-motion work on Coraline: https://youtu.be/k1kSZSdZmeQ
Martin's restoration of the Cain robot from Robocop 2: https://youtu.be/tg4KtybPbSg

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
